title: Phase 3 Exit Improvements: profit_target_exit wiring + trailing stop + mean_reversion opposite band + RSI-adaptive targets
description: Wire the profit_target_exit() function from TASK-001 into all 6 strategy templates' generate_signals(), add trailing stop ATR multiplier to trend_following and volatility_breakout, improve mean_reversion exit from bb_middle to opposite band × 0.98, and add RSI-adaptive profit targets for trend_following.
action: In all 6 templates (trend_following, mean_reversion, volatility_breakout, elliott_wave, funding_rate, macd_crossover): import profit_target_exit from _runtime, add profit_take_pct and max_holding_bars params with per-strategy defaults, compute profit_exits = profit_target_exit(close, entries, profit_take_pct, max_holding_bars), combine with existing exits via exits = exits | profit_exits. In trend_following: add trailing_stop_atr_mult param (default 3.0), compute trailing stop exit when close < max(close_since_entry) - atr * trailing_stop_atr_mult. In volatility_breakout: same trailing stop logic. In mean_reversion: change exit from bb_middle crossing to opposite band × 0.98 — long exit when close > bb_upper * 0.98, short exit when close < bb_lower * 0.98. In trend_following: add RSI-adaptive profit targets where profit_take_pct adjusts based on RSI level at entry.

rationale.chosen_approach: Profit targets are the most direct lever for improving win rate — currently 0 of 6 templates have any profit-taking mechanism. Trailing stops protect gains in trending moves. Mean reversion's bb_middle exit causes frequent whipsaws; opposite band × 0.98 gives more room for mean reversion to play out while still capturing the reversion move. RSI-adaptive targets reduce profit_take_pct in overbought conditions (tighter target, higher win rate) and increase in oversold (more room, larger moves).
decision_factors: No profit target = no guaranteed wins, only trend-reversal exits that may never trigger
bb_middle exit in mean_reversion means exiting at the midpoint of the range, cutting profits short
Trailing stops let winners run while protecting against reversals — essential for trend/breakout strategies
RSI-adaptive profit targets adjust win rate / profit_factor tradeoff based on market condition at entry
rationale.tradeoffs: Tighter profit targets (lower pct) increase win rate but may reduce average profit per trade. The RSI-adaptive mechanism balances this by adapting to market conditions.

risks: profit_target_exit must handle entries that span multiple bars correctly (entry_price tracking)
Trailing stop implementation must correctly track highest close since entry, not all-time high
Mean reversion opposite band exit may delay exits in strong moves, increasing drawdown risk
6 templates all need modification — high surface area for bugs
